d: Job Summary: The HR Business Partner (HRBP) serves as the strategic HR partner for KSA Retail Operations by aligning HR initiatives with business objectives. The role is responsible for talent acquisition, employee relations, performance management, HR operations, compliance with Saudi Labour Law, Saudization, payroll coordination, and employee engagement while supporting overall business growth and operational excellence.
q: Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
5–8 years of HR Generalist/HRBP experience, preferably in retail.
Strong knowledge of Saudi Labour Law and government portals.
r: Partner with business leaders to support organizational goals and workforce planning.
Provide HR guidance on employee relations, performance, and policy implementation.
Drive employee engagement, retention, and productivity initiatives.
Ensure timely manpower planning and hiring.
Monitor Saudization targets and localization initiatives.
Oversee employee lifecycle activities including onboarding, transfers, promotions, confirmations, and separations.
Coordinate payroll inputs, attendance, leave, overtime, and final settlements.
Maintain accurate HR records and HRMS updates.
Coordinate performance appraisal cycles and succession planning.
Handle employee grievances, disciplinary actions, and exit interviews.
Ensure compliance with Saudi Labour Law and company policies.
Coordinate activities through Qiwa, GOSI, Muqeem, Mudad, and other government portals.
Support visa, Iqama, and employment documentation processes.
Prepare HR reports and dashboards (headcount, attrition, recruitment, Saudization, etc.).
Coordinate administrative activities, employee accommodation, travel, and vendor management.

d: At BKN301, we build fintech solutions that enable banks, fintechs, and merchants to grow and innovate across emerging markets.
We are a financial technology group headquartered in London, with offices in Milan (Italy), Doha (Qatar), and San Marino, and our reach across new regions is growing fast.
Our teams work with energy and purpose, think internationally, and act as one, delivering fintech solutions that are practical, scalable, and built to last.

With colleagues spread across different countries and markets, diversity of experience is part of our everyday work. Learning from each other's perspectives helps us solve problems faster, adapt as the landscape evolves, and deliver better outcomes for our clients.

BKN301 is an international fintech in full growth, and we believe our people should grow as fast as our technology.Whatever your role, your work makes a difference: you'll contribute to the initiatives behind our expansion into key markets and help lay the foundations of our long-term success.

Our Riyadh team is just getting started. You'll be part of establishing our presence in the city, strengthening the relationships that matter, and supporting BKN301's long-term growth across the Kingdom.
Here, every contribution is recognised, new ideas are welcome, and innovation is open to everyone. Our people are the reason we succeed.
q: Hands-on experience in KYC/KYT, AML, or customer due diligence within financial services, fintech, or payments.
Familiarity with customer risk assessment, screening, enhanced due diligence, and escalation procedures.
Ability to review documentation thoroughly and maintain accurate, well-supported case records.
Professional proficiency in Arabic and English.
Exposure to on-chain digital asset businesses.
Soft Skills That Make a Difference
Integrity and discretion when handling sensitive information.
Sound judgment in recognising when a case needs escalation.
Consistency and reliability, even under high volumes.
Ability to work independently within defined procedures.
Curiosity and willingness to improve how things are done.
r: As KYC/AML Analyst, you'll be on the front line of protecting a new digital asset business. You'll run customer onboarding and ongoing KYC/AML checks with accuracy and consistency, applying approved procedures and flagging the cases that need a closer look. Working closely with Compliance, you'll help make sure every customer relationship starts and stays on a solid, well-documented footing.
The role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and is open to candidates based in the GCC who are willing to relocate.
A few examples of your responsibilities
Review customer identification documents and check onboarding information for completeness and consistency.
Conduct customer due diligence, including beneficial ownership verification where applicable.
Run sanctions, PEP, and adverse media screening using approved tools and procedures.
Assess customer, transaction/transfer, and corporate action risk, and carry out enhanced due diligence in line with established criteria.
Record your findings and escalate higher-risk cases, discrepancies, or potential suspicious activity to Compliance.
Keep case files complete and up to date, supporting periodic reviews and documentation updates.
Perform manual checks where needed and suggest improvements to workflows and tool.
x: The opportunity to be part of building BKN301's presence in the Kingdom from its earliest days.
Ongoing learning and room to grow within an innovative group.
An international, collaborative culture where trust comes first.

At BKN301, we believe the best ideas come from different perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer that values diverse backgrounds, cultures, and experiences, and we welcome applications from all qualified candidates.
